GPT-SoVITS Fabric

Speech synthesis and voice model training for Windows

GPT-SoVITS Fabric is an open-source desktop application from Turing Mirror based on GPT-SoVITS. It brings text-to-speech, character audio, annotation review, vocal separation and model training into one workspace.

GitHub ↗（Opens in a new tab）

The Windows installer is being prepared.

Features

  • Speech synthesis

    Choose a character and reference audio, synthesize one or more texts, and export WAV or FLAC files.

  • Character library

    Keep model weights, reference audio and annotations together in character packs you can import, edit and export.

  • Dataset preparation and training

    Separate vocals, split audio and review transcript annotations, then fine-tune SoVITS and GPT models with the training queue.
